name: Ticketmaster Discovery API
tagline: Search live events, venues, and attractions across Ticketmaster inventory worldwide
description: Ticketmaster's Discovery API provides read-only access to event, venue, attraction, and classification data from Ticketmaster's global inventory. Developers can search and filter concerts, sports, arts, and other live events by keyword, location, date, classification, and more, with paginated JSON responses suitable for event discovery apps and aggregators.

auth.details: API key via apikey query parameter (self-serve developer portal signup)

pricing.free_tier_limits: Default Public API access: 5,000 requests per day and 2 requests per second.

rate_limits: 5,000 requests per day and 2 requests per second by default. The Discovery API reference inconsistently states 5 requests per second; the lower Discovery-specific FAQ limit is used conservatively.
use_cases: search concerts near a city by keyword and date range
look up venue details and upcoming events at a venue
find attractions and related event listings
filter live events by classification (music, sports, arts)
paginate discovery results for an event finder app
